contracts: src/mocks/MockCurveStablePair.sol, MockCurveDolaMetaPool.sol, MockCurveStableSwapNG.sol, MockUniswapV3SwapRouter.sol, MockUniswapV3QuoterV2.sol, MockSkyPSM.sol (sellGem/tin added)

DeployUniswapHelperMainnet.onChainMutation: at most ONE tx: CREATE UniswapHelper(...) from the Ledger signer (OWNER prank in PREVIEW)
DeployUniswapHelperMainnet.offChainMutation: writes server/deployments/progress.uniswap-helper.1.json (broadcast mode only, during forge's local pass - before the tx is mined)
DeployUniswapHelperMainnet.addressBookParser: _bookAddress L116: matches '\n  <key>: "' and parses the next 42 chars; first match wins; absent key => address(0) => _requireBook reverts
preconditions: V3 router factory != 0; quoter.factory == router.factory; V3 WETH/USDC pool exists at fee 500
DeployUniswapHelperMainnet.notPreflighted: Curve DOLA-3CRV underlying index 2 == USDC (helper hardcodes it)
DeployUniswapHelperMainnet.idempotence: progress file names a helper with code => re-check immutables and send nothing; names a helper with NO code => revert (forge local-pass write never landed)

VerifyUniswapHelper.entry: run() L33 (non-view because QuoterV2 quotes are state-changing; sends nothing)
VerifyUniswapHelper.resolution: helper = address book `UniswapHelper` if non-zero else progress file; both non-zero must agree
checks: if pair exists: book PhusdSusdsPair (if non-zero) == pair; non-zero quotes for 1000 units of each stable both ways and both ETH routes
VerifyUniswapHelper.skips: quote smoke test when pair is zero (pre-cutover) - verify passes with no pair

UniswapV2Deployer.action: vm.deployCode of vendored WETH9, UniswapV2Factory(feeToSetter), Router02(factory, weth) artifacts from script/uniswap-artifacts/*.json
UniswapV2Deployer.trust: vendored creation bytecode must be canonical (init-code hash must match Router02's pairFor); NatSpec notes the vendored Router02 lacks removeLiquidity (UniswapHelper L330-332) - so the artifact is NOT the canonical mainnet Router02 build (ASSUMED a reduced build)

actions: deploy MockUniswapV3SwapRouter + QuoterV2, MockCurveDolaMetaPool(dola, usdc), MockCurveStableSwapNG(usde, usdc)
fund: 100 WETH (wrapped from caller ETH) + 200k USDC on V3 mock; 1M each side on Curve mocks; 1M USDS to the PSM mock
topUpDemoBalances mints DOLA/USDe/USDS/USDC shortfall and mints sUSDS shares to `who`

venueMocks.MockCurveStablePair: fixed 1:1 decimal-scaled price minus feeBps (default 4); owner-only setFeeBps; pays from own balance
venueMocks.MockUniswapV3SwapRouter: fixed owner-set rate per pair, fee deducted as fee/1e6; checks deadline and amountOutMinimum; rejects msg.value
venueMocks.MockUniswapV3QuoterV2: VIEW (real QuoterV2 is non-view/revert-based) - forwards to router.quote
venueMocks.MockSkyPSM: sellGem(usr, gemAmt): usds = gemAmt*conv - tin fee, pays from pre-funded USDS reserve; setTin/setTout unguarded test helpers
venueMocks.fidelity: constant-price venues: no price impact, so slippage/minOut behaviour of UniswapHelper routes is not exercised on anvil
